stories.title: 一张老桥的照片
stories.titleEn: A Photo of the Old Bridge
paragraphs: Last Saturday, Mei visited a village beside a river. Her uncle took her along a footpath through tall bamboo. At the end of the path, they reached a stone bridge. Her uncle said that people in the village had used the bridge for many years.

Mei wanted to take a photo for her class. She walked a little farther to get a clear view of the bridge. On Monday, she put the photo on a map of the village. She drew a star beside it so her classmates could find the landmark.
translation: 上周六，梅去了河边的一个村子。叔叔带她沿着穿过高高竹林的小路走。在小路尽头，他们来到一座石桥。叔叔说，村里的人用了这座桥很多年。
梅想拍张照片带到班里。她又走了一小段，好把桥看清楚。周一，她把照片贴在村庄地图上，并在旁边画了一颗星，方便同学们找到这个地标。

stories.title: 会漏水的陶碗
paragraphs: During a visit to an exhibition, Yun saw a clay bowl under a glass cover. The exhibit was small, so she bent down to see the lines on its side. She also looked up at the painted ceiling. Its blue birds gave her an idea.

At home, Yun made her own bowl and drew a bird on it. When the clay was dry, she put a little water inside. Water came out through a tiny hole. Yun smiled and put a plant in the bowl. She set it by the window with a plate under it.
translation: 参观展览时，芸看到了玻璃罩下的一只陶碗。展品很小，她弯腰看碗边的线条。她还抬头看了有彩绘的天花板。上面的蓝色小鸟给了她一个主意。
回到家，芸自己做了一只碗，在上面画了一只鸟。陶土干后，她往里倒了一点水。水从一个小孔里漏了出来。芸笑了，把一株植物种进碗里，再把碗放在窗边，下面垫了一个盘子。

stories.titleEn: A Book Without a Price Tag
paragraphs: At the school book fair, Tao helped at a booth for used books. He found a storybook with a drawing inside. The book had no price tag. Tao asked his teacher what to do with it.

The teacher saw the drawing and remembered that a young writer had left the book there after a talk. It was her own copy. Tao made a notice for the booth. He also gave a flyer to the librarian, who knew the writer. The next day, the writer came back for the book and thanked Tao for keeping it safe.
translation: 在学校书展上，涛帮忙照看二手书摊位。他发现一本故事书里夹着一张画。书上没有价签。涛问老师该怎么处理。
老师看到画，想起一位年轻作家做完分享后把书留在了那里。那是作家自己的书。涛给摊位写了一张告示，还给认识那位作家的图书管理员送去一张宣传单。第二天，作家回来拿书，感谢涛帮她保管。

stories.titleEn: The Handle of the Paper Pot
paragraphs: Our class practised a short play for the school gala. I played a cook and carried a paper pot onto the stage. Just before our turn, I saw that the handle of the pot had come off. We had only a minute to fix the prop.

Lin found some tape. I held the handle while she put the tape around it. Then we walked out and began the play. At the end, we heard loud applause. After the show, our teacher asked how we had fixed the pot so quickly. We told her it was teamwork.
translation: 我们班为学校联欢会排练了一个短剧。我扮演厨师，要拿着一口纸锅上台。快轮到我们时，我发现锅柄掉了。我们只有一分钟来修这个道具。
林找来了一些胶带。我扶住锅柄，她把胶带绕上去。然后我们走上舞台，开始演戏。结束时，我们听到了响亮的掌声。演出结束后，老师问我们怎么这么快就修好了锅。我们说是靠团队合作。

paragraphs: Bo stayed home on Tuesday because he had a cold. He had a runny nose, and he kept a tissue beside his bed. His class was preparing a song, so Bo worried that he would miss the practice.

After lunch, his friend Jia sent him an email. She told him the class had practised the first part of the song. She also told him to rest and learn it when he felt better. On Thursday, Bo was back at school. Jia sang the first part slowly, and Bo joined in the second time.
translation: 博周二因为感冒待在家里。他流鼻涕，就在床边放了一张纸巾。他们班正在准备一首歌，所以博担心自己会错过练习。
午饭后，朋友佳给他发了一封电子邮件。她说全班练了歌曲的第一段，也让他先休息，好些了再学。周四，博回到了学校。佳慢慢唱了一遍第一段，第二遍博就跟着唱了。

stories.title: 把书留到明天
paragraphs: Nina loved reading under her lamp after dinner. On Friday, she wanted to finish her book, so she decided to stay up. The next morning, Nina felt drowsy at the breakfast table. She missed part of a game because she took a long nap.

At dinner, Nina and Dad sat down to discuss a new plan. They chose an earlier reading time and left ten minutes for getting ready for bed. Nina put a paper star between the pages. Now she could stop at a good place and look forward to the next chapter. Her evenings felt more balanced.
translation: 妮娜喜欢晚饭后在台灯下读书。周五她想把书读完，就决定晚睡。第二天早晨，她在餐桌边困得直打瞌睡。因为午睡睡了很久，她错过了一部分游戏。
晚饭时，妮娜和爸爸坐下来商量新计划。他们把阅读时间提前，并留出十分钟准备睡觉。妮娜把一颗纸星星夹在书页之间。现在她能读到合适的地方就停下来，期待明天读下一章。晚上的安排更均衡了。

stories.titleEn: A Trip Plan in a Jar
paragraphs: Jun wanted to visit the science museum with his cousin. A ticket cost twenty yuan. Jun had twelve yuan in his jar, so he decided to save up. Each week he put part of his pocket money into the jar and wrote the amount on a small card.

After three weeks, Jun counted twenty-one yuan. He could afford his ticket, with one yuan left. His cousin found a free show at the museum. They planned to see the show after lunch. Jun put the card in his bag to remind himself how he had reached his goal.
translation: 俊想和表姐一起去科学博物馆。一张票要二十元。俊的罐子里有十二元，所以他决定攒钱。每周他都把一部分零花钱放进罐子，再把金额写在一张小卡片上。
三周后，俊数了数，一共有二十一元。他买得起门票，还能剩下一元。表姐发现博物馆有一场免费的表演。他们打算午饭后去看。俊把小卡片放进包里，好记住自己是怎样实现目标的。

stories.title: 纸盒里的火星
paragraphs: On science day, our group made a model of Mars in a cardboard box. We used red sand for the soil. Nina pressed a ball into the sand to make a crater. I made a rover with bottle tops for wheels.

Our mission was to move the rover from one side of the box to the other. It rolled well until a wheel fell into the crater. We moved some sand to make a road around the hole. This time the rover reached the other side. We drew both routes on our poster to show what we had learned.
translation: 科学活动日，我们小组在纸盒里做了一个火星模型。我们用红沙来表示土壤。妮娜把一个球按进沙子里，做出了一个环形坑。我用瓶盖当轮子做了一辆探测车。
我们的任务是让探测车从盒子的一边到达另一边。起初车滚得挺顺，后来一个轮子掉进了坑里。我们挪了些沙子，铺出一条绕过坑的路。这次车到达了另一边。我们把两条路线都画在海报上，展示学到的东西。

stories.title: 云散以后
paragraphs: On a cool evening, Wei and her aunt took a small telescope to the roof. They wanted to see the moon. At first a cloud covered most of the sky. Wei drew the roof and the trees in her notebook while they waited.

After a few minutes, the cloud moved away. A thin crescent appeared above the horizon. Her aunt helped her point the telescope at the moon. Wei could see the bright edge much more clearly. She added the shape to her drawing. She planned to come back a few days later to see how it had changed.
translation: 一个凉爽的傍晚，薇和姨妈带着一架小望远镜上了屋顶。她们想看月亮。一开始，一片云遮住了大半天空。等候时，薇在本子上画了屋顶和树。
几分钟后，云飘开了。地平线上方出现了一弯细细的月亮。姨妈帮她把望远镜对准月亮。薇把明亮的月边看得更清楚了。她把月亮的形状添到画里，打算过几天再来看看它有什么变化。

stories.title: 花园里的太阳能灯
stories.titleEn: The Solar Lamp in the Garden
paragraphs: Our garden path was dark in the evening. Dad bought a small solar lamp to light the way. We put it beside a flowerpot under a tree. The lamp was bright on the first night and very weak on the second.

In the morning, I noticed that the tree kept the lamp in shade for most of the day. Dad and I moved it to a sunny spot. There, light from the sun could charge its battery. That evening, the lamp shone again. I drew two pictures to explain where the lamp got its energy.
translation: 我们花园的小路到了傍晚就很暗。爸爸买了一盏小太阳能灯照路。我们把它放在树下一个花盆旁。第一晚灯很亮，第二晚却很暗。
早上，我注意到那棵树一天的大部分时间都把灯遮在阴影里。我和爸爸把灯移到有太阳的地方。到了那里，太阳光能给它的电池充电。当天晚上，灯又亮了。我画了两幅画解释灯从哪里获得能量。

stories.title: 旧瓶的新用途
stories.titleEn: A New Job for Old Bottles
paragraphs: The art club wanted to grow beans by the classroom window. We had seeds and soil. We looked around for a small container for each plant. Jia brought two empty bottles from home, and our teacher helped us cut them in half.

We put soil in the bottom of each bottle and planted the seeds. We used another bottle to carry water. After a week, tiny leaves appeared. Now we refill the water bottle at the tap when it is empty. Our class wrote a sign to show how we can reuse things and reduce waste.
translation: 美术社想在教室窗边种豆子。我们有种子和土，四处找能装每株植物的小容器。佳从家里带来两个空瓶，老师帮我们把它们切成两半。
我们把土放进瓶底，种下种子，再用另一个瓶子装水。一个星期后，小叶子长了出来。现在水瓶空了，我们就在水龙头接满。我们班写了块牌子，告诉大家怎样重复使用物品、减少浪费。
